pages.title: Attoscale Transistor
pages.text: A switch that changes between superposed states before it is asked to, because it anticipates its input. It is a thousand times smaller than a femtoscale transistor and faster by the same factor. It is invisible and very fast.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator, I joined a Femtoscale Transistor to a Superposition Crystal through a Topological Insulator with Exotic Solder. It began switching before the input arrived.
